_instructions.creation: Use package_agent.py against already-authored files. This unfilled template cannot pass installation validation or grant permission.
_instructions.generated_identity: agent_id equals the current approved entry_skill. Skill names and entry must exactly match the current constructor build gate; counts are variable.
_instructions.blueprint: Generated packages pin id, integer revision, SHA256 and approval_source obtained from the current build gate. A copied manifest is provenance, not actual human authority.
_instructions.skill_record: Each item records name, path=skills/<name>, files={relative_path:SHA256}, modes={relative_path:ordinary_POSIX_mode_integer}. Required metadata and local entry references must be valid.
_instructions.final_evidence: Generated packaging also invokes current bundle-check on the unpacked files. Expected blueprint artifacts must be unpacked deliverables, never the final archive or a self-referential checksum.
_instructions.factory: Factory purpose is reserved for the exact current constructor's own one-skill core and cannot bypass target approval.
_instructions.delivery_boundary: Prepared files, project placement, host discovery, invocation, product execution, external registration and publication are separate states. No credentials belong in this manifest.
_instructions.operating_standard: New generated exports carry agent-operating-standard/1, current release and exact hashes of all portable operating resources. Legacy packages remain distinguishable; installation does not fabricate adoption or semantic proof.
_instructions.visual_identity: Choose project/system by the accepted purpose, independently of installation path. New project-specific icons use project-card-v1. Reusable system skills record reusable_system source basis and a bound actual existing system-style sample for created icons. Preserve existing exact visual identity and class; classification grants no permissions.
